description: Class representing a custom XML part.

Delete.description: Deletes the XML from the custom XML manager.

returns.description: True if the XML was successfully deleted.

DeleteAttribute.description: Deletes an attribute from the XML node at the specified XPath.

params.description: The XPath of the node from which to delete the attribute.
params.name: xPath

params.description: The name of the attribute to delete.
params.name: name

returns.description: True if the attribute was successfully deleted.

DeleteElement.description: Deletes an XML element at the specified XPath.

params.description: The XPath of the node to delete.
params.name: xPath

returns.description: True if the element was successfully deleted.

GetAttribute.description: Returns an attribute from the XML node at the specified XPath.

params.description: The XPath of the node from which to get the attribute.
params.name: xPath

params.description: The name of the attribute to find.
params.name: name

returns.description: The attribute value or null if no matching attributes are found.

GetAttribute.signature: GetAttribute(xPath: string, name: string): string | null

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiCustomXmlPart class.

GetId.description: Returns the ID of the custom XML part.

GetNodes.description: Retrieves nodes from custom XML based on the provided XPath.

params.description: The XPath expression to search for nodes.
params.name: xPath

returns.description: An array of ApiCustomXmlNode objects corresponding to the found nodes.

GetXml.description: Retrieves the XML string from the custom XML part.

InsertAttribute.description: Inserts an attribute into the XML node at the specified XPath.

params.description: The XPath of the node to insert the attribute into.
params.name: xPath

params.description: The name of the attribute to insert.
params.name: name

params.description: The value of the attribute to insert.
params.name: value

returns.description: True if the attribute was successfully inserted.

InsertAttribute.signature: InsertAttribute(xPath: string, name: string, value: string): boolean

InsertElement.description: Inserts an XML element at the specified XPath.

params.description: The XPath of the parent node where the new element will be inserted.
params.name: xPath

params.description: The position at which to insert the new XML element. If omitted, the element will be appended as the last child.
params.name: index

returns.description: True if the insertion was successful.

InsertElement.signature: InsertElement(xPath: string, xmlStr: string, index?: number): boolean

UpdateAttribute.description: Updates an attribute of the XML node at the specified XPath.

params.description: The XPath of the node whose attribute should be updated.
params.name: xPath

params.description: The name of the attribute to update.
params.name: name

params.description: The new value for the attribute.
params.name: value

returns.description: True if the attribute was successfully updated.

UpdateAttribute.signature: UpdateAttribute(xPath: string, name: string, value: string): boolean

UpdateElement.description: Updates an XML element at the specified XPath.

params.description: The XPath of the node to update.
params.name: xPath

params.description: The XML string to replace the node content with.
params.name: xmlStr

returns.description: True if the update was successful.
